summary: helion-kernel-wrapper.call hard-codes the silu_mul_fp8 picker and kernel for every op, so rms_norm_per_block_quant keys abort with 'no such key: intermediate'. pick_config (rms_norm_per_block_quant.py:103) is not modeled.
The opcheck schema and aliasing checks on tensor storage are below the model. The translatable control flow passes: the static branch reaches the op with [128, 4096].

No dynamic_shapes_config.type setting or branch exists (kernels-ops). Warm-up and generate never enter support-torch-compile.call under VLLM_COMPILE, because run-pw-graph calls <arch>.forward directly (worker-runner). The direct AOT and JIT paths and the eager baseline agree with the code. Logprob closeness is numeric.
The only assertion is assert_close on GEMM output. The translatable control flow passes: all 12 shapes reach _C::cutlass_w4a8_mm through the wrapper.
The only assertion is assert_close against a reference MoE. The translatable control flow passes: w13 and w2 are prepacked, then _C::cpu_fused_moe runs.

RocmDotScaledMxfp8LinearKernel is missing. The nearest entity, model-opt-linear-method.apply, returns only owner_ms, so the asserted (num_tokens, n) output shape cannot be read and no kernel is selected. The finite and relative-error checks are numeric.

count_expert_num_tokens (fused_moe/utils.py:199) is missing: fused-moe-utils models only swiglu-limit-func. The rule (per-rank exact counts through expert_map, -1 excluded) is expressible in CEL, so this is a coverage gap.
